parameterisation.form: cubic B-spline in time of day
parameterisation.note: The queue is produced only by the recurrence, so Q(t) always carries Q(t-1). The speed-implied queue is the fitting target, which makes the residual a measure of model adequacy rather than a tautology.

identifiability.note: With no queue, Q is identically zero for any lambda below mu. Those bins are handed to step 5 rather than reported as estimates.

lambda.note: lambda above mu is what builds the queue; a peak ratio below 1 would mean the fit produced a queue without demand ever exceeding service.
